Retain the durable project-scoped chat URL so admission creates a successor gateway session and can reopen the provider conversation without replaying an ambiguous turn. Added regression coverage for automatic defaults and explicit conversation URL ownership.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed BigCherry request admission failures caused by reusing a gateway session that had already failed or closed. The provider chat is now retained for silent successor-session recovery, and terminal-session reuse is covered by tests.

technical-summary: Disambiguate duplicate local worktrees by accepting an explicit managed project-root path, reject unresolved workspace labels fail-closed, and serialize GPT conversation successor selection with exception-safe locks. Reuse only workflow-valid active sessions; terminal, closing, expired, failed, and unknown states retain the chat URL for successor admission. Added focused workspace and lifecycle regression tests.
user-summary-candidate: Resolved workspace ambiguity caused by duplicate AUDiaGentic worktrees and hardened silent GPT-session recovery against terminal-session reuse and concurrent successor creation.

technical-summary: Route status, diagnostics, response, and evidence requests by durable request ownership before slug-based workspace resolution. This removes ambiguity when duplicate worktrees share a project slug and preserves fail-closed behavior when the same request exists in multiple roots.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed MCP status routing so a request created in an explicitly selected workspace can still be polled even when duplicate worktrees share the same project name.

technical-summary: Bound presubmit reconciliation retries independently from generic recovery so a proven-unsent request cannot remain indefinitely queued behind an unresolved predecessor while emitting only owner heartbeats. Added provider-session-presubmit-recovery-max-attempts with a bounded default and regression coverage.
user-summary-candidate: Prevent gateway requests from appearing active forever when a previous GPT turn is unresolved but the new prompt was never submitted.

technical-summary: Changed the shared GPT-auto CDP endpoint from loopback to the configured remote Chrome DevTools endpoint http://10.10.100.10:9222. Remote mode remains attach-only.
user-summary-candidate: Point GPT-auto CDP at the remote browser on 10.10.100.10.

technical-summary: Treat a uniquely correlated, non-generating terminal assistant remount with completion controls as a safe response-slot replacement instead of raising ProviderBindingIntegrityError. Restrict the fallback to the same conversation, unique latest prompt, one assistant, durable message IDs, and a terminal witness. Extend standalone recovery transport timeout to 90 seconds so two-snapshot remote CDP capture is not mislabeled as gateway unavailability.
user-summary-candidate: Prevent completed BigCherry responses from being marked failed when ChatGPT remounts the assistant DOM node, and make recovery wait long enough for remote CDP capture.
